description.value:
You read people easily. Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in the Insight skill, or expertise if already proficient. As an action, you can study one humanoid within 30 feet that you can see, making a Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by its Charisma (Deception) check. On a success, you gain advantage on attack rolls and ability checks against that target until the end of your next turn.
